name: Anrakyr the Traveller
oracle_text: Lord of the Pyrrhian Legions — Whenever Anrakyr the Traveller attacks, you may cast an artifact spell from your hand or graveyard by paying life equal to its mana value rather than paying its mana cost.
blocked_sentences: Lord of the Pyrrhian Legions — Whenever Anrakyr the Traveller attacks, you may cast an artifact spell from your hand or graveyard by paying life equal to its mana value rather than paying its mana cost.

needs.what: a pay-life price on cast_from_hand: during the attack trigger's resolution, optionally cast one artifact card from your hand or graveyard (zones: ["hand", "graveyard"], selector types ["Artifact"]) right then, ignoring timing, paying life equal to its mana value as an alternative cost instead of casting it free (e.g. a `pay_life_instead: true` option on cast_from_hand)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cast_from_hand already takes zones and a selector and casts during resolution, but only without paying its mana cost (op_cast_from_hand offers only the free cast), so it would make the artifact free rather than cost life. grant_playable with playable_pay_life_instead, limit 1 and playable_cast_only has the right price but only leaves a standing permission at normal timing, so a non-flash artifact could not be cast during combat when the trigger resolves and would instead be castable later in the turn, which is a different card
